title: Umlindo Wabafelweyo
intro: Uza kudibana nomphefumlo ovavanywa kukwahlukana okukhulu, amehlo awo ayesazi ulwimi lweenyembezi kodwa intliziyo yawo ayizange ilahle ithemba. Kwibali lokukhohlisa, ulangazelelo, kunye nokudibana kwakhona ekugqibeleni, lo mkhonzi uhloniphekileyo ka-Allah waba luphawu lomonde ngonaphakade. Ngubani owanyamezela iminyaka yentlungu efihlakeleyo, kodwa waphinda wabona kwaye wavuya ngomzuzwana omnye?
clues: Ndingumprofeti ogama lakhe laba luphawu lomonde xa ndijongene nokulahlekelwa okukhulu.
Ndabusiswa ngoonyana abaninzi, kodwa omnye wathathwa kum ngenxa yomona wabanye.
Uthando lwam ngalowo ulahlekileyo lwalunzulu kangangokuba amehlo am ajika aba mhlophe ngenxa yentlungu, kodwa andizange ndikhale ngaphandle kuka-Allah.
Ndithumele oonyana bam ukuba baye kukhangela lowo ndandimlahlekile kunye nomntakwabo, ndibabongoza ukuba bangalilahli ithemba.
Xa kufika umthwali weendaba ezilungileyo, ndagqunywa ngehempe ebusweni, kwaye ngequbuliso ihlabathi lacaca kwakhona.
Ndibizwa ngokuba ndinguSirayeli, kwaye koonyana bam abalishumi elinambini kwaphuma izizwe ezilishumi elinambini zesizwe esikhulu.

arabic: فَلَمَّآ أَن جَآءَ ٱلْبَشِيرُ أَلْقَىٰهُ عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِۦ فَٱرْتَدَّ بَصِيرًۭا ۖ قَالَ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verse: And when the bearer of good tidings arrived, he cast it over his face, and he returned [once again] seeing. He said, "Did I not tell you that I know from Allāh that which you do not know?" (12:96)
